metadata.case_name: LEUNG CHUN TUNG v. SIU WAI CHEONG

plaintiff.occupation_before: office assistant and driver (South African Airways)
plaintiff.education_level: formal education up to primary four; attended evening school and completed form one of secondary school

injuries.description: Fractured left ilium and acetabulum with dislocation of left hip; fracture-dislocation of the left hip joint with comminuted fracture around the acetabulum; avascular necrosis of the femoral head resulting in collapse and flattening; permanent damage to the hip joint with incongruity and instability resulting in gross subluxation of the femoral head.
source: X-ray photographs showed fractured left ilium and acetabulum with dislocation of left hip.
Mr Leung suffered severe injury to the left side of his pelvis in the motorcycle accident.
What was even worse was the fracture dislocation of the left hip joint.
In spite of being treated aggressively with open reduction and internal fixation, the hip joint has been permanently damaged.
There is incongruity and instability of the joint resulting in gross subluxation of the demoral head.
There is also avascular necrosis of the femoral head resulting in collapse and flattening.
injuries.icd_description: Multiple injuries of hip or thigh

manifestations.description: pain and stiffness of his left hip
gross subluxation of the femoral head
reduced mobility / much reduced degree of mobility

treatments_received: open reduction of the fractured areas (16 March 1990)
arthroscopy of the left hip (23 October 1990)
removal of the left ilicar crest plate (29 April 1991)

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: He was a kung fu instructor and a scout master before the accident and was actively engaged in canoeing and wind-surfing activities; these activities were curtailed by his injuries.
The injuries leave the victim with a much reduced degree of mobility and progressive deterioration of the left hip joint.

Unable to continue work as a kung fu instructor and scout master and unable to perform certain delivering and sales duties; his activities and employment as an active instructor were curtailed by his injuries.
